title: Sony’s legal battle against Tencent’s Horizon ‘clone’ is already over
summary: In July, Sony sued Tencent to prevent the release of Light of Motiram, a game Sony alleged was a "slavish clone" of its popular Horizon series. But the legal battle is already over; the two companies have reached a "confidential settlement" and the case has been dismissed with prejudice, according to a court document filed […]

title: ‘No evidence’ Australia’s Bondi gunmen trained in the Philippines: Official
summary: Philippine official said 'mere visit' to the country does not support claims the men underwent 'terrorist training'.

title: Tankers With Russian Oil Shunned by India Pile Up Off China
summary: A growing number of ships laden with Russia’s Urals oil are piling up off China, in the hope that independent refiners there will take the crude as Indian demand ebbs due to US sanctions.
